title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — The Not-Delivered Orders' Share of the Mileage Posting
content:
**Rule.** The amount taken back for orders verified as not delivered on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch is the not-delivered orders' share of the batch's mileage posting, found as that posting's amount multiplied by the number of wrong-address violations recorded against the batch and divided by the batch's order count, rounded to the cent half up, and it never exceeds that mileage posting; a batch carrying no mileage posting has nothing to take back on this ground.

## Inputs and where they are read

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Mileage posting | The mileage pay entry among the batch's earnings entries |
| Wrong-address violations | Those recorded against this batch on the shopper's contractor account |
| Order count | The orders in the batch, as recorded on the batch |

## Worked figures (hypothetical batches)

| Mileage posting | Wrong-address violations against the batch | Orders | Amount taken back |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4.40 | 1 | 3 | 4.40 multiplied by 1, divided by 3, is 1.4667, rounded to 1.47 |
| 6.30 | 2 | 3 | 6.30 multiplied by 2, divided by 3, gives 4.20 |
| 3.10 | 1 | 1 | 3.10, the whole posting |
| None | 1 | 2 | Nothing — no mileage posting to take back from |
| 5.00 | 0 | 2 | Nothing — no order shown as not delivered |
